 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. CHICAGO – The Marquette men's basketball team is trying to go 1-1 on its big tests this week.
 The Golden Eagles (2-1) dropped their first road match at Michigan on Nov. 11 , and they get another challenge when MU faces Missouri (2-1) in a neutral court game Nov. 15 at the United Center.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Last season, the Golden Eagles were 0-5 in non-conference games against power-conference teams.

(Jovanny Hernandez / Milwaukee Journal Sentinel) Nigel James Jr. ends scoreless drought
 02:48 PM ET, November 15 2026, Ben Steele 
 Marquette fans don't have to worry about Nigel James Jr..
 After going scoreless against Michigan, the MU sophomore guard got in the scoring column by getting into the line and finishing with a nice layup over a tough contest.
 Nolan Minessale in for Damarius Owens in Marquette's starting lineup
 02:30 PM ET, November 15 2026, Ben Steele 
 Nolan Minessale, a former Marquette University High School star, is making his first start for MU.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Minessale takes the place of Damarius Owens, who was a little banged up in the second half of the loss to Michigan. But Owens is suited up and on the bench for the Golden Eagles.
 Missouri will be without forward Mark Mitchell
 01:46 PM ET, November 15 2026, Ben Steele 
 Missouri forward Mark Mitchell will not play in the game with a concussion.
 The 6-foot-9 Mitchell only played one minute against SIU-Edwardsville, but he had 21 points against St. Louis.
